service.name: Corporate retreat entertainment in Breckenridge
service.serviceType: Live music for corporate retreats and incentive events
service.description: Live music for corporate retreats and private celebrations at Breckenridge venues, solo through quartet, planned for 9,600 feet.

faqs.q: Does 9,600 feet change what the band costs?
faqs.a: No. The travel line is the same one Vail and Beaver Creek carry, and there's no altitude line on the quote. What changes at Breckenridge is the plan: a longer setup window, a longer sound check, paced sets and retunes between them. Signet Artists books Breckenridge retreat evenings from Denver.

Reported at 55 dBA by day and 50 after hours in residential zones, 70 and 65 in commercial, with the town manager able to permit above them. We couldn't reach the code text directly, so we treat your venue's number as the one that governs and build the night under it. Dinner plays at the level of the conversation, well inside any of these at a sensible distance.

faqs.q: What does setup need at this altitude?
faqs.a: Setup usually runs 45 to 90 minutes depending on the size of the band, and at 9,600 feet we take the generous end and fix the dock or door time with the venue in advance. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with real breaks. The band needs one or two dedicated 20-amp circuits, not shared with catering warmers, which is the most common setup fault we plan against.
